claim: The demo opens a spoken French greeting with a selected line, a 3-second speaking gap, three repeats, and one practice entry.
where: landing action, demo page, demo documentation, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; assert the shipped recording, selected transcript line, settings, existing log, and Listen to speaking-gap transition

claim: An imported audio clip can use a selected transcript line, play, pause for speaking, and play again.
where: landing headline and how-it-works section, footer, README
sandbox: fresh real workspace; import a WAV, select its second transcript line, set two repeats, and assert Listen → Your turn → Listen → complete

claim: Demo data stays separate from real browser data, can be reset, and is cleared when leaving demo mode.
sandbox: fresh browser context seeds a real audio clip, mutates and resets demo, exits, then verifies real data remains and demo storage is gone

claim: The demo and saved audio clips reload offline after their first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context imports a WAV, visits /demo/, then reloads both demo and real workspaces with context.setOffline(true)

claim: The demo exports its practice log as CSV.
where: Export log CSV button, landing export section, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; inspect the downloaded header and one row per sample session

claim: The player exports a backup with audio clips and restores that backup.
where: Export backup and Import backup buttons, landing export section, privacy page
sandbox: demo backup downloaded and inspected, then imported into a fresh real workspace

claim: Imported audio and practice history stay in this browser without analytics, advertising, or third-party practice requests.
where: landing fact and privacy section, empty state, footer, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh real workspace imports a WAV, selects a line, completes two repeats, reloads the saved session, records all requests, and scans runtime source for tracking clients

claim: Deleting an audio clip removes the audio clip and its existing local practice history.
sandbox: fresh real workspace imports a WAV, completes a session, proves one clip and one log exist, deletes, then proves both stores are empty

claim: The player does not score speech, provide lessons, act as a language course, run a hearing test, or assess pronunciation.
where: landing privacy and limits section, terms page
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the limits statement and the absence of scoring, lesson, hearing-test, assessment, or advertising actions

claim: The cassette artwork was generated for this product.
sandbox: read the original asset sidecar, assert generator, deployment, prompt and review, then load the shipped art and disclosure

claim: The project builds to dist as a static site with its player, demo, legal, 404, and deployment configuration.
where: README run, deploy, and routes sections
sandbox: clean checkout; the Playwright web server runs the production build, then the test asserts every required artifact exists in dist
